summary: Frontend e2e validation of NAME HARMONY (service_categories → home tiles, /taxi hub, /course header) + full client→driver standard ride. Tested on the preview URL with rider.i18n@demo.sb and jean.dupont@demo.sb. 5/7 review items PASS. Two critical bugs found: (1) /course page main title (H1) is hard-coded to 'Planifiez votre trajet' for every mode (mode chip below the title is correct, but the big page header is not, breaking NAME HARMONY for standard/pool/bidding/electric/access); (2) /course?mode=bidding does NOT redirect to /taxi-bidding — it still renders the inline bidding panel.

ui_bugs.issue: Main page H1/H2 title is always 'Planifiez votre trajet' regardless of mode. mode=standard shows 'Planifiez votre trajet' (should be 'Taxi VTC'); mode=pool shows 'Planifiez votre trajet' (should be 'Pool- partage'); mode=electric shows 'Planifiez votre trajet' (should be 'Électric'); mode=access shows 'Planifiez votre trajet' (should be 'Handicapé'); mode=bidding shows 'Planifiez votre trajet' (should be 'Proposez votre tarif'). Only mode=book_later coincidentally matches. Mode chip [data-testid=ride-choose-mode-chip] is correct in all cases — the bug is in the page-title binding only.
'Prix estime' (missing accent) — should be 'Prix estimé'. Same bug as iteration_157, still not fixed.

integration_issues.issue: /course?mode=bidding does NOT redirect to /taxi-bidding. The page stays on /course?mode=bidding and renders panel-bidding inline. Spec (review request) explicitly requires: '/course?mode=bidding (now titled Proposez votre tarif) must redirect to the dedicated /taxi-bidding page'. taxi-bidding-page testid not found after hard-reload.

action_items: Fix RideChoosePage header binding: the H1/H2 must use catName (from service_categories matched by mode.id) — not a hardcoded string. Verify with mode=standard → 'Taxi VTC', mode=pool → 'Pool- partage', mode=electric → 'Électric', mode=access → 'Handicapé', mode=bidding → 'Proposez votre tarif'.
Add a top-level effect/guard in RideChoosePage (or router) that redirects /course?mode=bidding → /taxi-bidding so the inline bidding panel is no longer shown.
Fix 'Prix estime' → 'Prix estimé' in driver IncomingRequestSheet (translations.driver.est_price).
critical_code_review_comments: RideChoosePage.js: the header title appears to be statically rendered (always 'Planifiez votre trajet') while the mode chip is dynamic. Suggest reading cat?.name||mode.label once at the page level and binding it to BOTH the main page-title AND the chip — currently only the chip is bound.

Bidding separation: keeping the bidding panel inside RideChoosePage means future changes risk re-introducing the 'Enchères' UX inside /course. A small useEffect(() => { if (mode==='bidding') navigate('/taxi-bidding'+location.search) },[mode]) would cleanly enforce the separation.

service_categories shape returned correctly with admin renames: book_later='Planifiez votre trajet', electric='Électric', bidding='Proposez votre tarif', access='Handicapé', rental='Mise à Dispo', etc. — backend contract is good.

success_rate.frontend: 71% — 5/7 items PASS: home name harmony, /taxi hub names, mode-chip names, standard E2E (rider → driver accept), pool seat panel. 2/7 FAIL: /course page-title is hardcoded for non-book_later modes; /course?mode=bidding does not redirect.

seed_data_creation: Created 2 standard rides via UI + POST /api/rides as rider.i18n@demo.sb (ride_df504376eb8a — used in the UI flow; ride_688995e3da1d — used to verify the driver-side incoming sheet within 7s and successful accept).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use UI flow: click 'Ou choisir une autre option de connexion' → 'Email' → fill email/password. Rider auto-redirects /login→/home if already authed: clear cookies+storage (context.clear_cookies + localStorage.clear) before switching to driver. Driver demo (jean.dupont@demo.sb) starts already 'En ligne' — no need to toggle. Pending-ride poll fires in ~7-8s after rider POST /api/rides. service_categories endpoint /api/service-categories returns the admin-renamed labels. RideChoosePage page-title vs mode-chip are bound to DIFFERENT data sources — the chip uses cat.name, the title appears hardcoded to 'Planifiez votre trajet'. Bidding redirect: only the 'Proposer mon tarif' button (inside panel-bidding) navigates to /taxi-bidding — there is NO automatic redirect on entering /course?mode=bidding.

rca of the issue.course_header_hardcoded: The page-title element on /course is rendering a fixed string 'Planifiez votre trajet' instead of catName||mode.label. The mode chip is dynamic so the header binding is the only mismatch. Likely RideChoosePage.js renders a static heading separately from where the chip is computed. The fix is to read cat?.name||mode.label from service_categories at the page-title level too.
rca of the issue.bidding_no_redirect: RideChoosePage currently renders the bidding panel for mode=bidding instead of redirecting to /taxi-bidding. The 'Proposer mon tarif' button inside the panel does navigate, but the spec requires an automatic redirect on entering /course?mode=bidding. Add: useEffect(()=>{ if(mode==='bidding'){ navigate('/taxi-bidding'+location.search, {replace:true}) } },[mode]).
